extraction.notes: RUN-2026-02 comparator step (P4 step 4, LIM-0048), RI-TEC-036 only (update of case CMP-0008). Read the Chapter 10 main findings (page 15), public administration reform service delivery (page 29), the business environment passage (page 62), Chapter 3 (page 75) and Chapter 10 (page 82); screened the whole text for e-Albania, portal, e-government, e-services, online services, digital services, NAIS, AKSHI, transactional and accessibility (also with spaces removed). Not extracted: 'Service delivery to citizens and businesses is broadly in place' and the service delivery pillar of the PAR Strategy action plan, and 'No progress was made on reducing administrative burden' (page 29: public services in general, no digital element); 'public service delivery remains heavily centralised in Tirana' (page 62: no digital element); digital skills, cybersecurity, eID law and the Law on Digital Services consultation (page 82: other issues); RI-FMW-015 and RI-TEC-038 material (outside this source's scope in the brief). The 2026 Chapter 10 key recommendations no longer include the 2025 request to improve access to the use of e-services (ALB-EU-2025-001-0001).
